category_title: Low-achieving EFL learners exhibiting hesitation, distraction, and lack of participation in mainstream classes
scenario_title: Task avoidance and distraction in mainstream class
minimal_context: The student is working in a pair with a peer to complete an English exercise in a regular mainstream classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please work with your partner to complete the exercise on the worksheet. You need to take turns answering the questions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks at her partner's paper instead of her own) Um... okay.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think the answer to the first question is?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Answers with hesitation and poor pronunciation) I... I think it is... I am not sure. She can answer it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to do your own work and participate in the pair activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pulls out her mobile phone and looks down, remaining subdued) I will just let her do it. I don't want to answer.
